subject: Harden @zonoid/cli init: safe + cross-platform install into other repos
description:
Make `npx @zonoid/cli init` (packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js) safe to run in any repo and fully working cross-platform (esp. Windows). Root cause: the CLI hard-codes INSTALL_DIR = ~/.claude/orchestrator, which is ALSO the default CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA data dir; checkInstallDir() runs `rm -rf INSTALL_DIR` when source files are missing, destroying live overlay/sessions/worktrees data. It also wires .sh hooks (bash/jq/curl — broken on Windows) and installs skills via bare fs.symlinkSync (EPERM on Windows).

INVARIANTS (the judge will check these):
1. NO DATA LOSS: never delete a directory that contains live data subdirs (overlay/, sessions/, worktrees/, the `workspace` file, or `token`). Add a `dirHasLiveData(dir)` predicate. If the dir has data but is missing source, auto-heal WITHOUT deleting data (e.g. clone to a temp dir via fs.mkdtemp, copy source files in with fs.cpSync, preserving data subdirs) — or abort with a clear, actionable message. Never `rm -rf` a data dir.
2. CROSS-PLATFORM: replace `execSync('rm -rf ...')` with fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true}) applied only to non-data/temp dirs. Skills install (checkSkills): wrap fs.symlinkSync in try/catch; on failure retry fs.symlinkSync(src,dest,'junction') for dirs, then fall back to fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true}); update the 'already linked/valid' detection to accept a real copied dir (skill.md present) as valid.
3. REUSE LOCAL CHECKOUT: add resolveInstallDir() — if the repo root above the running script (path.resolve(__dirname,'..','..','..')) contains daemon.js + mcp-graph.js + package.json, use THAT as INSTALL_DIR (no clone, no rm). Else fall back to ~/.claude/orchestrator + clone-if-missing. This makes `node <checkout>/packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js init` use the existing checkout safely; the npx path (cli package alone, no daemon.js sibling) still clones.
4. CLAUDE WIRING DELEGATES TO bin/install.js: for harness 'claude', replace the hand-rolled checkSettings()+checkMcp() with spawning `node <INSTALL_DIR>/bin/install.js --workspace <cwd> [--port <ORCH_PORT>]` so .mcp.json + .claude/settings.json get the Node (.js) hooks and the FULL hook set (incl. orch-gate-bash, orch-posttool-starttask) — matching bin/install.js exactly, no drift. Keep checkClaude() (CLAUDE.md merge) since bin/install.js does not do it. Fix/relax checkHooks() so it validates the .js hooks (or drop the brittle .sh presence check). Leave cursor/codex/opencode adapter wiring unchanged (out of scope).
5. TESTS: extend test/cli-init.test.js with pure-function coverage for dirHasLiveData (use os.tmpdir fixtures: returns true when overlay/ has entries, false for an empty/temp dir), resolveInstallDir (prefers a checkout with daemon.js+mcp-graph.js), and the skills link-strategy selector. Export the new helpers from zonoid.js. Existing tests must stay green. No network in tests.

VERIFY: run `node test/cli-init.test.js` (must pass) and `npm run test:all` if quick. Manually confirm (dry-run / temp dir) that resolveInstallDir picks the checkout and that checkInstallDir refuses to delete a dir containing an overlay/ subdir.

summary: Implemented all 5 invariants in packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js and extended test/cli-init.test.js. (1) dirHasLiveData() guards checkInstallDir() — never rm-rfs a dir containing overlay/, sessions/, worktrees/, workspace or token; auto-heals by clone-to-tmp + selective cpSync. (2) All rm-rf shell calls replaced with fs.rmSync(…,{recursive,force}); checkSkills() wraps symlinkSync with junction and cpSync fallbacks for Windows. (3) resolveInstallDir() prefers a local checkout 3 levels above packages/cli/bin when daemon.js+mcp-graph.js+package.json are present; INSTALL_DIR is now dynamic. (4) Claude harness delegates .mcp.json+settings.json to bin/install.js via spawnSync; CLAUDE.md merge kept separately; checkHooks() validates .js hooks. (5) 27 tests all pass (node test/cli-init.test.js) including 9 new pure-function tests for dirHasLiveData, resolveInstallDir, and skills link chain. No rm-rf in executable code. Committed on orch/attempt/3d98f672-2b47-4ef5-8282-f4db45cf1808-1 (commit 049688a).

item.value: JUDGE VERDICT (single-attempt, flat tier) — APPROVE / hold-for-main. Reviewer: cli-hardening-judge-1, 2026-06-16.
item.why: All 5 task invariants independently verified in commit 049688a on orch/attempt/3d98f672-2b47-4ef5-8282-f4db45cf1808-1. Tests re-run by judge from the attempt worktree: exit 0, 27/27 pass (9 new). Data-loss safety proven: the only fs.rmSync(INSTALL_DIR) is gated behind !dirHasLiveData(); no executable rm -rf or execSync/spawnSync('rm') remains (full-file confirmed, only 2 comment mentions). dirHasLiveData markers (overlay/, sessions/, worktrees/, workspace, token — all root-level) exactly match the daemon's real data layout (verified vs lib/overlay.js:14, hooks/lib/hookkit.js:81, daemon.js:222). Auto-heal cannot clobber data: clones to a fresh tmp dir, copies only non-protected top-level entries, deletes only stale source files (line 93 guarded by protectedNames) — never INSTALL_DIR itself; nested clobber impossible since all live data lives in root-level protected entries. Invariant 3 resolveInstallDir() prefers a complete checkout and degrades gracefully to ~/.claude/orchestrator for the published-package layout. Invariant 4 checkClaudeWiring delegates to bin/install.js (verified to exist, accept --workspace/--port, and wire the full .js hook set incl. orch-gate-bash + orch-posttool-starttask); checkClaude() kept; checkHooks() validates the 4 .js hooks; sound fallback to inline checkSettings+checkMcp when bin/install.js is absent.

code_review.winner_notes: Correct, well-scoped (+262/-13, 2 files), no dead code, no scope creep. rmSync replaces rm -rf cross-platform; skills install has symlink->junction->copy fallback (junction is dirs-only but skills are always dirs). Tests for dirHasLiveData and resolveInstallDir are non-vacuous (real fixtures, positive+negative, meaningful branch asserted).
concerns: C1 (test quality): the skills-fallback test re-implements the symlink->junction->cpSync chain inline instead of invoking checkSkills(); on the host only the symlink branch runs, so the junction/cpSync fallbacks — the Windows paths this PR adds — get zero test coverage. Asserts a real post-condition (dest + skill.md exist) so not vacuous, but the new branches are untested.

C2 (defensive gap, not a loss path): auto-heal protectedNames omits runtime state files (agents.json, loops.json, op-cache.json, certs/); they survive only because a fresh git clone does not contain them. Safe today; slightly fragile if the clone ever ships such a file.

C3 (pre-existing style): git clone ${REPO_URL} ${tmpDir} is unquoted, matching the existing unquoted clone at line 113; would break on a path with spaces. Temp dir under os.tmpdir() makes this low-risk and it is not introduced by this diff.
